I've seen this picture before attributed to Simo, but if the description of the rifle is true, this is not he. Simo used a Finnish Mosin-Nagant chambered to 7.62x54. not 6.5x55. I know this is largely nitpicking, but in Finland that cartridge was 7.62x53R which is for the most parts similar to 7.62x54R. Finnish Mosins were chambered to x53R (casing length 53.5 mm) and Russian Mosins were typically chambered to 54R (53.7 mm). The difference is small, unless it happens to be in the chamber of a loaded rifle.
